# Shaping a boule

A boule is a round loaf of bread. Shaping builds surface tension on the dough so it holds its height in the oven instead of spreading flat. Shaped dough goes into a floured banneton for [[Proofing dough]].

Turn the dough onto an unfloured counter, round it loosely with a bench scraper and let it rest twenty minutes so the gluten relaxes.

Fold the edges into the centre, flip the dough seam side down and drag it toward you to tighten the skin before [[Scoring loaves]].
